ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

2. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of.
   B. Apply the teaching of Pillars of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Pillars of has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Pillars of to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Surah Naas? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Surah Naas with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Surah Naas.
   C. Use Surah Naas to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Surah Naas has no place in daily life.

   A. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.

5. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily

   C. Use The Enlightened Beings able to: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Enlightened Beings able to:.
